definition.simple: The process of throwing out the garbage and waste that your body makes inside its cells.
definition.academic: The physiological process of eliminating metabolic waste products from the body.

examples: Sweating when you are hot and peeing are both forms of excretion.

common_misconceptions: Students confuse excretion (removing cellular waste like urine) with egestion (removing undigested food like feces).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student what would happen to a city if the garbage trucks stopped working.
